Hi Riverbend Health team,

Thanks for following up. I can confirm this is the same issue we're already tracking on ticket TKT-122022 ("Spend dashboard not refreshing - E-6105"), which was opened on 17 Oct and is still open. To avoid duplicate work, I've linked this follow-up to that ticket and it will be handled there — you'll receive all updates on TKT-122022.

For context, error E-6105 is typically caused by an expired integration credential. If you'd like to try a quick fix in the meantime, a tenant administrator can:
1. Open Admin > Integrations > Credentials.
2. Regenerate the credential and update it in the connected system.
3. Trigger a manual sync and confirm the job status shows Completed.

If that doesn't resolve it, our team will pick it up on the original ticket. Please let us know if you'd like us to collect the tenant ID, affected record ID, exact error text, and time of failure (UTC) to speed up the investigation.

Best regards,
Support Team
